packs.name: Lucide
packs.note: Feather’s successor. Same 2px round-cap hand, far wider catalog, still shipping.

packs.name: Feather
packs.note: The 2px original most stroke sets descend from. Small, even, no longer growing.

glyphs.name: lock

packs.name: Phosphor
packs.note: Drawn on a 256 grid with a soft geometric hand. Six weights upstream, regular here.

packs.name: Heroicons
packs.note: Tailwind’s set. 1.5px strokes at 24, with solid and 20px mini twins for dense UI.

packs.name: Tabler
packs.note: The widest stroke catalog here, uniform enough that mixed rows read as one hand.

packs.name: Radix Icons
packs.note: A 15px grid built for product chrome. Crisp at control size, thin if you scale it up.

packs.name: Bootstrap Icons
packs.note: Filled paths on a 16 grid, so weight holds at any size. More literal than the stroke sets.

packs.name: Iconoir
packs.note: 1.5px strokes on 24 with an open, geometric hand. Roomier than Lucide at the same size.
